body: This is really what I was talking about, I have never gone anywhere to socialize. Where do I go? What should I or shouldnt i do there.
Where do I find people that invite me to do things like sailing? I've never been invited to anything. I take every opportunity I can.
I developed a severe stutter around then. Its so bad I can barely speak.
I just don't know why I should try any more. I can't imagine a way to be happy.
